question: DM-INGEST-LEDGER-COMMIT-CONTRACT names sourceReference and provenance{kind:statement_import} fields that the shipped LEDGER public contract does not expose. Should the data model be reconciled to the shipped shape (InitialEvidence: RegisterEvidenceInput with EvidenceKind.statement_row, returned as Evidence[]) before the commit saga is built?
context: Discovered by TASK-INGEST-GATE-INT-LEDGER-CONTRACT (bd-2dg). RecordTransactionInput exposes AccountId, SignedAmount, CurrencyCode, TransactionDate, PostingDate?, OriginalDescription, InstrumentId?, CardholderId?, InitialEvidence. TransactionDetail returns Evidence[] (TransactionEvidenceDetail). There is no sourceReference or provenance member on either. Statement provenance round-trips through evidence and is proven by Statement_provenance_round_trips_through_initial_evidence. Downstream commit beads (FR-INGEST-APPROVED-BATCH-COMMIT, FR-INGEST-DURABLE-RECEIPT-RESUME) freeze this request byte-for-byte, so the DM must name the real fields.
